title: This Tree Is 4,850 Years Old - Older Than Pyramids
caption:
This tree is older than the pyramids. Seriously.
A cartoon hiker snaps a photo of a twisted old pine, guessing it's only about a century old.
The fact: Methuselah, a bristlecone pine, is 4,850+ years old - older than the Egyptian pyramids.
If this tree could talk, what story would you ask it to tell?
Share this with a friend who loves wild nature facts.
